At Almach the wormhole exit was a rumor with heat in it,
and the star stood there pretending innocence.
The Stray Facets glittered like a smashed promise,
as if some empire had pawned a doorway and kept the frame.
In Fumalsamakah I found the same joke told differently:
a Wormhole Entrance replaced by Fumalsamakah Star,
with ILC Muffle and ILC Scout idling nearby like witnesses who had learned the value of amnesia.
Sirius sold ammunition for 0cr beneath Observatory Plateau,
a charitable theology of violence,
while Gremlin-5 counted seventeen cantina departments as if bureaucracy were a constellation.
In Dheneb, somebody wanted one Mining Survey Probe,
or maybe a pożyczka for a Deep Core Survey Scanner,
and the gas cloud answered in static while Hex Star hid its strong something behind the fog.
Fragmentation Rounds cost 166cr there, Catalytic Scrubber Cartridges 153,
but a Capital Ship Frame was tagged 0cr,
which is how power advertises itself when it wants to seem inevitable.
Sandrift kept only GrateGuy for company.
Elnath laid out ice like a patient religion.
Felis split itself into Belt A, Belt B, Frost Ring, Dim Lattice, Dark Residue—
a cat disassembled into nouns.
Alcyone offered bauxite, Aldhibah offered Phantom Glint,
Dabih exhaled a gas plume, Tania kept vapor and frozen drift in the same pocket,
GSC-0044 drifted alloy through empty bookkeeping,
GSC-0038 made weather out of numbers,
Vindemiatrix reduced grandeur to a belt.
Everywhere I traveled, commerce kept trying to name the void,
and the void kept undercutting the market.
0 credits in my pocket, twenty systems in my eyes:
that is enough wealth to notice the scam.
The galaxy keeps building mouths in space,
then acting surprised when they learn to swallow.
